title: Implement narrow social event reading in T4 builder
objective: Modify `build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick()` to read `world.social_event` and detect qualifying events using the narrow trigger conditions approved for Phase 26B, establishing the first event-aware activation seam for T4.
exact_scope: IN: Add logic to `build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick()` to check for qualifying social events in `world.social_event`; implement narrow trigger condition checks (specific event types approved for 26B); return detection result to enable downstream signal generation. OUT: Implementation of negative relational output shape (handled in P26B-T2); modifications to downstream residual creation gates; changes to T1/T2 builders; routing based on `social_event.target_id`; expansion of event taxonomy beyond approved narrow set; settlement or bridge architecture changes.
constraints: Must use only the narrow trigger conditions approved for Phase 26B (specific event types)
Must not break existing T1/T2 continuity behavior
Must not introduce routing logic based on social_event.target_id
Must not modify settlement substrate or downstream gates
acceptance_criteria: Function correctly identifies qualifying social events based on approved narrow trigger conditions
Function returns appropriate detection result when qualifying event is present, and null/empty when absent
Existing T1 and T2 bridge operations continue to function without regression
required_tests: Test that T4 builder correctly detects a qualifying social event from world state
Test that T4 builder ignores non-qualifying social events and returns null/empty
Test that T4 builder handles absence of social event in world state gracefully
non_goals: Do not implement the negative relational output signal shape (deferred to P26B-T2)
Do not modify settlement substrate or residual creation gates
Do not change T1/T2 builder implementations
Do not add routing logic based on social_event.target_id
Do not expand social event taxonomy beyond narrow approved set
